steps.en: Moves to the CFC stage from PLUS are refused
steps.id: Pindah ke stage CFC dari PLUS ditolak

steps.en: Some requests are marked not applicable
steps.why_en: These requests are silently skipped and answered as successful, not treated as not applicable.
steps.why_id: Permintaan ini dilewati diam-diam dan dibalas sukses, bukan diperlakukan sebagai tidak berlaku.

steps.en: Stage move is checked against the stage rules
steps.id: Perpindahan stage dicek terhadap aturan stage
steps.why_en: The stage rule check was removed for PLUS requests, so any stage can be requested.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan aturan stage dihapus untuk permintaan PLUS, jadi stage apa pun bisa diminta.

steps.en: Each notice's condition is checked before the change
steps.id: Kondisi tiap notice dicek sebelum perubahan
steps.why_en: The detailed notice checks used by staff are not applied to PLUS requests.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan rinci notice yang dipakai staf tidak diterapkan untuk permintaan PLUS.

steps.en: Missing or duplicate notices are caught and reported
steps.id: Notice yang tidak ada atau dobel ditangkap dan dilaporkan
